title: Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. translated_title: 面向统一多目标模型的混合训练合并方法
translated_abstract: 统一语言模型日益被期望在单一参数集中融合异构能力，例如数学、代码、指令遵循以及可控的思考行为。一种常见的解决方案是对多个目标进行顺序后训练，但这会将所有目标纠缠在同一条优化轨迹上，使最终模型对训练顺序、数据比例、训练日程和停止准则高度敏感。权重空间合并提供了一种模块化的替代方案，但对单目标专家模型进行朴素合并往往失败：领域能力急剧退化，或者思考/非思考模式坍缩为单一主导行为。我们将这两种失败归因于不兼容的权重空间几何结构：在单一目标上训练的专家模型会漂移到参数空间中相距遥远的区域，使其插值落在任何共享低损失盆地之外。我们提出了混合训练合并（MTM），该方法在每个分支上进行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出混合训练合并（MTM），通过在混合目标上训练各分支使其权重空间几何相互兼容，从而实现统一多目标模型的可靠合并，同时保留多领域能力与可控思考行为，避免顺序后训练的高敏感性和朴素合并导致的能力退化与模式坍缩。
en_tdlr: Proposes Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on a mixture of objectives to keep weight-space geometry compatible, enabling reliable merging into a unified multi-objective model without capability degradation or think/non-think mode collapse.
